title: 事故与未遂事件报告
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/161_事故与未遂事件报告.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/161_事故与未遂事件报告/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白报告单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank report form with a small warning icon, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第七课：事故与未遂事件报告。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a big question mark floating beside it.
shots.narration: 没人受伤，还要不要报告？

shots.scene: 阿杰端着一摞试剂瓶，最上面的滑落
shots.prompt_en: In a university lab, the young male student carries a stack of bottles, the top bottle slips off.
shots.narration: 阿杰抱着一摞试剂瓶，上面一瓶滑落。

shots.prompt_en: The bottle lands on a rubber floor mat and bounces without breaking, the young male student sighs in relief.
shots.narration: 好险，瓶子掉在垫子上，没碎。

shots.scene: 阿杰把瓶子放回去，想当没发生
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly puts the bottle back on the shelf and looks around, a finger on his lips.
shots.narration: 他想：没事，就当没发生吧。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sees this from across the lab and shakes her head with a concerned look.
shots.narration: 小研摇头：这可得报告。

shots.scene: 非预期的意外，有伤害有损失
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unplanned event icon with arrows to an injured hand, a broken instrument and a polluted drain. No text.
shots.narration: 事故，是没有预料、造成损失的意外。

shots.scene: 人受伤、财物损坏、环境污染
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an injured person, a cracked machine and a spill reaching soil. No text.
shots.narration: 可能伤人，损坏财物，污染环境。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large warning triangle over a lab with an ambulance arriving. No text.
shots.narration: 严重的，甚至会造成人员死亡。

shots.scene: 扎伤、烫伤都是已经发生的伤害
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pricked finger and a burned hand each marked with a red dot meaning harm already done. No text.
shots.narration: 关键：伤害或损失已经发生。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hammer falling from a shelf and landing right next to a person's foot. No text.
shots.narration: 锤子掉下来，砸在脚边，没砸到人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny gap between the hammer and the foot highlighted by a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 差一点就伤到人，这叫未遂事件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ghost image of the hammer hitting the foot shown faintly, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 没伤到人，但它本来可能伤人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person shrugging and walking away from the fallen hammer, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 未遂是警告，不能当没发生。

shots.scene: 事件分成两类：事故和未遂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one box labeled with an exclamation icon splitting into two boxes, one with an injury icon and one with a near miss icon. No text.
shots.narration: 意外事件，分事故和未遂两类。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with a pricked finger and a splash on skin, a red mark. No text.
shots.narration: 造成伤害或暴露，就是事故。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle caught just before it hits the floor, a green check over the person. No text.
shots.narration: 差点出事、没有伤害，叫未遂。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a needle that has pierced a finger, a quiz buzzer icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 针头已经扎伤手指，算什么？

shots.scene: 答案：事故；两者都要报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the pricked finger marked as an accident, and both boxes with arrows to one report form. No text.
shots.narration: 是事故。两种都要报告、找原因。

shots.scene: 小研操作注射器，针头刺破手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with a syringe and the needle tip pokes through her glove.
shots.narration: 小研不小心，针头刺破了手套。

shots.prompt_en: Close view: the female graduate student checks her finger through the torn glove, no visible wound.
shots.narration: 还好，皮肤好像没被扎到。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hesitates, a thought bubble with a speech icon and a question mark.
shots.narration: 没受伤，要不要告诉别人？

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the older man right away, holding up the torn glove.
shots.narration: 要说，而且要马上说。

shots.scene: 接触过病原等样品，按暴露处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torn glove beside a biohazard warning sign, an arrow to a report form and a doctor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 涉及生物样品，按暴露程序处理。

shots.scene: 冰山：水面上一小块，水下一大块
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an iceberg with a small tip above water marked with an injury icon and a huge part below marked with many small warning icons. No text.
shots.narration: 未遂事件，是水面下的冰山。

shots.scene: 这次没扎进，下次可能扎进
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two needles, the first stopped at a glove, the second going into a finger, an arrow between them. No text.
shots.narration: 这次没伤到，下次可能就扎进去。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a changing room shelf with only small gloves, a hand in a tight small glove that tears inside the lab. No text.
shots.narration: 手套不合适戴了小号，进去就破了。

shots.scene: 阿杰如实报告，补齐尺码
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports the torn glove to the safety administrator, who adds more glove sizes to the shelf.
shots.narration: 如实报告，才补齐了合适的手套。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tall stack of small report forms next to a small accident icon, a downward arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 险情报得多，大事故反而少。

shots.scene: 从不报险情，风险藏起来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: warning icons being swept under a rug, a crack spreading on the floor. No text.
shots.narration: 从不报险情，是把风险藏了起来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cut finger with a plaster and a small burn on a hand. No text.
shots.narration: 小磕碰、小割伤，也要报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand being rinsed and bandaged, then an arrow to a report form and broken glass going into a sharps box. No text.
shots.narration: 先清洗包扎，再报告、登记。

shots.scene: 受伤了马上告诉导师，不拖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with a week crossed out and a person telling a supervisor icon on the same day. No text.
shots.narration: 受伤马上告诉导师，别拖一周。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person who breathed a little gas, feeling fine now, a clock icon with a delayed warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 有的伤害，过一阵才显出来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person unsure with a question mark, an arrow to a supervisor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 拿不准轻重，也要马上报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person at a pipetting bench holding a sore wrist and lower back, an arrow to a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 手腕劳损、腰背疼，也要报告。

shots.scene: 发现松动的插座、漏水的管道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose power socket and a dripping pipe under a bench, each with a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，马上报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hazard icon written into a blank register, then a wrench fixing the pipe. No text.
shots.narration: 登记上报，及时整改。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand covering a hazard icon crossed out, a hand pointing at it checked. No text.
shots.narration: 不瞒不藏，下次才不会真出事。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: many report forms feeding into a simple bar chart icon with one tall bar highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 统计分析，才知道哪里要改进。

shots.scene: 溢洒、破管、设备损坏都报
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a spill, a broken centrifuge tube and a damaged rotor, each with an arrow to a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 溢洒、破管、设备损坏，都要报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of an injury, a sick person and a near miss, all going into one register. No text.
shots.narration: 伤害、疾病、险情，都要登记。

shots.scene: 报告内容：时间地点人物经过
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report form with a clock icon, a map pin, a person icon and a chain of event icons. No text.
shots.narration: 说清时间、地点、人员和经过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the report form continued with an injury icon, a first aid icon and a question mark for cause. No text.
shots.narration: 后果、已做的处置、可能的原因。

shots.scene: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow chain from a lab icon to a supervisor icon, a school building icon and a university office icon. No text.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和学校。

shots.scene: 生物样品还要报生物安全员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a biohazard warning sign with an arrow to the safety administrator. No text.
shots.narration: 生物类事件，也报生物安全负责人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report form with a check mark next to a law book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 发生事故，要按规定如实报告。

shots.scene: 迟报、漏报、谎报、瞒报，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a slow clock, a missing page, a mask and a hand hiding a paper, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不迟报、不漏报、不谎报、不瞒报。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hidden report found under a desk, a balance scale icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 瞒报谎报，要承担责任。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person hiding an injury, the injury icon growing larger over time. No text.
shots.narration: 隐瞒，还会耽误救治和处置。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank incident report form on a clipboard being filled in with icons only. No text.
shots.narration: 用专门的表格记录，方便追溯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pen writing on a form with an eye icon for truth, an eraser crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 如实记录经过，不添不减。

shots.scene: 起过火的设备挂停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser cutter with a blank out of service tag, a wrench icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 出过事的设备，先停用检修。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab area roped off with a barrier tape icon and a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 保护现场，配合调查。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator smiles and accepts a report form from the young male student.
shots.narration: 报告，不是为了找人挨批。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a broken chain of safety barriers, finding the gap. No text.
shots.narration: 查清原因，是为了找出漏洞。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a big zero target on a wall and people hiding report forms behind their backs, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只追求零事故，可能逼出瞒报。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thumbs up icon over a person handing in a report, a gold star. No text.
shots.narration: 主动上报应当肯定，不是扣分。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a training class, an inspection checklist and a completed fix, all with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 多看培训、检查、整改做得怎样。

shots.scene: 实名和匿名两个报告渠道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two report boxes, one with a name tag icon and one with a mask icon, both connected to the safety office. No text.
shots.narration: 实名、匿名，报告渠道都要有。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report form sent and a reply message arriving quickly with a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 快速反馈，让人知道被重视。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a group meeting where the safety administrator thanks a student, others clapping. No text.
shots.narration: 公开感谢报告人，不责备。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a task list with each item ticked through to the end. No text.
shots.narration: 每项整改，都跟踪到完成。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loop of four icons, a magnifier, a plan sheet, a wrench and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 查原因、定措施、落实、复查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a procedure sheet being updated with a pencil and a bottle shelf fitted with a lip edge. No text.
shots.narration: 改规程、换物品，防止再发生。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new small alarm device mounted on a wall with sound waves. No text.
shots.narration: 比如加装报警，下次早发现。

shots.prompt_en: The older man shares a near miss story at a group meeting, students listening and nodding.
shots.narration: 把教训讲出来，别人就不再犯。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank near miss form, and a ledge is fitted to the shelf.
shots.narration: 阿杰报告后，货架加了防滑挡边。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an injury icon and a near miss icon side by side, both with arrows to a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 事故、未遂、隐患、小伤，都要报。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon and an eye icon over a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 及时、如实，不迟报不瞒报。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed loop arrow around a lab icon with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 不为追责，为整改，为分享教训。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a big magnifying glass and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：事故调查与根本原因分析。
